name: fz556_mental_herb_illusion
purpose: Zoroark, p2b, disguised as Ampharos, uses up its Mental Herb against Taunt (step 7): the -enditem carries the disguise's name, so the foe folds the use into Ampharos's row while Ampharos, on the bench, still holds its item (decision 0026 section 4); the break at step 8 gives the use to Zoroark's row. On main the knowledge invariant refused the disguise's row at step 7 (E_INVARIANT, issue 556). A battle of the differential fuzzing of issue 396 (free random sets, fz_354_32), whole. The choices and the seed are those of the campaign; the trace is recorded with the pinned Showdown (b2cb775).
